o1.biggest_strength: It centers the whole series on the two behaviors that actually predict retention and uses the allowed triggers well, including platform branching and a calm inactivity email.
o1.biggest_mistake: Email 5 is presented as one email with multiple conditional versions and ends up a bit messy; it also adds extra operational ideas that are useful but slightly crowd the core deliverable.
